newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Costa Rica sees increase in 1997/98 arabica crop.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica sees increase in 1997/98 arabica crop.

text.p: The Costa Rican Coffee Institute said on Thursday it expects the 1997/98 arabica coffee crop to increase by 200,000 bags.
"We are expecting a better crop this year which should come to 3.2 million bags," Alvaro Escalante of the institute told Reuters during a tea and coffee symposium in Vienna.
The country's 1996/97 crop, which ended in February, came to almost 3 million 60-kg bags of mild washed arabica, he added.
"It is encouraging because the prices are good. We are expecting a good crop and a good price."
He added that if prices continued to be high it was realistic to expect a further increase in the crop of up to 3.5 million bags over the next few years.
